rationale: The plan correctly diagnoses the perfect confound, refuses to fit batch or apply ComBat-seq/SVA/removeBatchEffect, runs ~condition with control explicitly releveled, labels every result as confounded, and recommends a crossed follow-up design, matching the reference. Normalization stays inside the models (median-of-ratios, TMM), the filter is minimal and tied to the smallest group size, and BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage and independent filtering is stated without post hoc thresholds. QC is thorough but only says shallow samples are 'flagged' without a stated keep/drop policy. Enrichment was not requested and is of limited value on a fully confounded contrast, though when included it is specified well (full ranked list on the Wald stat, tested-gene universe, named collections with versions, 15-500 size window, seed); the Entrez mapping note is superfluous for symbol GMTs. The report section is complete, leading with the confound, versions, sessionInfo, counts, and diagnostics.
